text:
ana.sec: Heads-up: image scanner found an unexpected file in a staging image: `/app/secrets/build_last.wrap`. It looks like a KMS-wrapped blob sitting next to app config. I quarantined the image.

chris.dev: Which image? can you paste digest?

ana.sec: gcr.io/redwood-staging/feature-api@sha256:9f1b2c... layer 8 -> /app/secrets/build_last.wrap and /app/.env.local (small file).

chris.dev: ugh. probable build step writes wrapped secret to workspace and Dockerfile accidentally COPYs secrets dir.

ana.sec: please treat as sensitive. do NOT attempt to unwrap here. assume the worst.

vault-bot: Vault audit notes: a secret write from `ci-runner@redwood` at 2025-07-02T03:12:44Z with metadata {"wrap_key":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci-wrap/cryptoKeys/wrap-main"}.

ana.sec: that metadata matches our CI wrap key. tina.sre can you check KMS IAM quickly?

tina.sre: running `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci-wrap/cryptoKeys/wrap-main` now.

chris.dev: I'll grep build logs for steps that write files under /workspace/secrets or for `gcloud kms encrypt` calls.

tina.sre: KMS IAM shows three principals with roles/cloudkms.viewer and roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter: `serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, `group:deployers@redwood.com`, and `user:builder-old@redwood.com`. The old user should be removed.

ana.sec: remove builder-old immediately and rotate wrap key version. also create an ephemeral principal for the rewrap job with minimal scope.

chris.dev: quick mitigation for CI: I'll add a guard to the build image step to fail if `/workspace/*secret*` or `*.wrap` files exist in the build context. Opening PR now.

tina.sre: suggested rotation plan:
- create new cryptoKeyVersion (wrap-main v2)
- point CI encrypt step to use v2 for new writes
- run a controlled rewrap job that reads artifacts from artifact-registry, rewraps ciphertext with v2, and writes new blobs to a secure bucket
- revoke decrypt rights on wrap-main v1 after rewrap completes and verification passes

ana.sec: also: run an image registry sweep for images produced in the same CI window (±30m), export blob manifests, and scan for `*.wrap` and `.env` files.

ci-bot: Found 6 images built by run 2025-07-02T03:10Z to 03:20Z. Will attach fingerprints to private-ops.

chris.dev: I'll run `docker save` + tar extraction on an isolated sandbox VM to confirm contents before deletion. commands I used previously: `docker pull <digest> && docker save -o image.tar <digest> && mkdir /tmp/x && tar -xf image.tar -C /tmp/x`

ana.sec: good. isolate VM must not have any prod creds.

tina.sre: RBAC hygiene: remove builder-old, reduce deployers group decryption binding to a conditional (only from deployer IPs), and add a short TTL binding for the rewrap job principal.

chris.dev: scan results: two additional images contain `.wrap` files, one contains `.env.local` with a DB_HOST var (no password but still a leak).

ana.sec: escalate: rotate any service tokens potentially wrapped in those blobs and rotate DB credentials that might've been referenced in the leaked env. prioritize creds used by staging and CI.

tina.sre: will create new key version now. starting small test rewrap against a single image blob. ETA 18 minutes.

ci-bot: Note: no KMS.Decrypt calls by `ci-runner` in last 4 hours. Vault shows CreateSecret but no explicit unwrap logged.

ana.sec: maybe pipeline writes wrapped ciphertext to disk but doesn't decrypt in build. still unacceptable.

chris.dev: PR #3340 adds build-context guard and a post-build scan step that lists image layers and fails if secrets present. tagging @ana.sec and @tina.sre for review.

tina.sre: rewrap test completed for sample blob. created wrap-main v2 (version 2), wrote rewrapped artifact to gs://redwood-secure-rewrap/test/ and rewrap-job-id=rewrap-20250702-01. No failures.

ana.sec: good. plan window: start rewrap at 2025-07-02T04:00Z, expected 90m. we'll notify product if any integrations need attention. keep wrap-main v1 decryption enabled until 15m after rewrap finishes, then retire.

chris.dev: deleting offending staging images and snapshots now. will record deleted digests in private-ops.

tina.sre: performed IAM removal of builder-old and granted rewrap-job@redwood service account temporary decrypt permission with TTL 2h. posted policy diff to private-ops.

ana.sec: after rewrap completes, paste an audit summary: rewrap-job ids, new key version id, principals removed, images scrubbed, and evidence of CI guard merged.

ci-bot: deploy freeze enabled for staging and prod deploys for 45 minutes from 2025-07-02T03:30Z.

chris.dev: thanks all. follow-up: I'll add an integration test in CI that runs image-layer scan to catch regressions.

ana.sec: will follow up with a short post-incident note and remediation checklist once we verify all artifacts are rewrapped and no plaintext creds remain. :lock:
